name: Timothy Mellon

lean.basis: Republican since the Reagan years (by his own account he earlier voted for Johnson, McGovern and Carter). Nearly all of his $227 million in federal giving from 2020 to mid-2024 went to Republicans, above all Trump's super PACs; his only Democratic gifts were to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez in 2018 ("to disrupt the Democratic Party") and Tulsi Gabbard in 2020.

current_role: Heir to the Mellon banking fortune; former owner of Pan Am Railways; Republican megadonor
summary: Timothy Mellon, a grandson of Treasury Secretary Andrew Mellon, built a railroad holding company (Guilford Transportation, later Pan Am Railways) that he sold to CSX in 2022. He was the second-biggest donor of the 2024 cycle, giving about $150 million to the pro-Trump MAGA Inc. and $25 million to a super PAC backing Robert F. Kennedy Jr. During the 2025 government shutdown he gave $130 million to help pay the armed forces.
